core-dsp.description: Build the portable deterministic audio renderer.

plugin.description: Build the SKSE plugin. Includes CommonLibSSE-NG's dependencies: it is consumed as a git submodule via add_subdirectory, so its own manifest does not drive resolution and this one must supply what its CMakeLists resolves (directxtk, rapidcsv, fmt, xbyak, spdlog).

tests.description: Build tests for the SKSE plugin.
